Maya (ml-eng): Heads-up — onboarding quant3-magnet-14B to staging. After ~6.4k tokens QA shows missing anchor facts when we resume generation. Looks like a KV recall gap tied to RoPE+int4. Anyone seen this pattern?
Sam (research): Not exactly, but I've seen window-wrap issues when prefill exceeds shard stride. Do you have a deterministic repro?
Maya (ml-eng): Yep, small repro gist -> https://gist.fake/repro-priming (steps below). Quick run: prefill 6400 tokens with anchor facts, then resume asking for anchor. Expected answer present, model returns blank/unknown. Logs show kv index jumps around.
Maya (ml-eng): Repro command:
```bash
python repro.py --model quant3-magnet-14B --prefill 6400 --resume "Who discovered X?"
```
Lee (infra): Can you paste the model cfg snippet? interested in rotary/rope params and max_ctx + quant dtype.
Maya (ml-eng): model_cfg: rotary_base=10000, rope_scale=1.0, max_ctx=8192, kv_dtype=int4 (we use our quant toolchain v3).
infra-bot: sched: started canary run canary-314 on ded-dev-gpu2 (ID: canary-314) :rocket:
Nikhil (quant): Try forcing rope_scale=0.999 or computing index in float64 for kvcache mapping — we've seen phase off-by-one after floor ops when reducing precision.
Maya (ml-eng): Quick patch: switched index calc to float64 and re-ran. recall improved (now ~6200 tokens) but still fails after 6400. Attached diff -> https://phab.fake/D123.
Sam (research): :eyes: Could it be prefix eviction or trimming? check prefill vs shard stride and whether we reshard across GPUs on resume.
Maya (ml-eng): Eviction logs show none, but we do get WARN entries: `WARN kv_map: index 8193 -> wrapped to 1` right at resume time. That smells like hitting max_ctx wrap and kvcache map not handling quantized offsets.
Lee (infra): Proposed bisect plan: (A) run FP16 (no quant) baseline, (B) disable rope scaling, (C) apply half_stride_fix (small memcpy/stride change). If A passes -> quantization-related; if B passes -> RoPE related.
Maya (ml-eng): Launching three runners: run/1750004321-A (fp16), run/1750004321-B (rope_off), run/1750004321-C (half_stride_fix). ETA ~25m, posting logs to /staging/canary.
infra-bot: canary runs finished: A=pass, B=fail, C=pass. Summary: FP16 baseline returns anchor correctly; disabling rope scaling did not help; half_stride_fix + int4 replicates FP16 behavior.
Nikhil (quant): Nice — points at stride/packing math in int4 prefill memcopy. I'll open a PR to fix packing alignment + add unit test for anchors > 6k tokens. Assigning to @Lee for review.
Maya (ml-eng): Logged CI ticket KV-REG-2026, keeping the canary live for 24h. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
Sam (research): Add a regression test in the eval harness that runs long-prefill recall for quantized models and checks for `kv_index_wrap` warnings.
Lee (infra): Will add alert rule: if WARN kv_map:index_wrap appears during resume we fail the canary.
Maya (ml-eng): Filing follow-ups: PR link (when ready), test plan, and an eval bench. Closing thread for now unless someone wants to add more notes.
